title: Illustration / Hybrid UI style — Design

location.series: IBM Design Language / public web guidelines
location.extent: Complete webpage content-area capture; visible default tab states

slide_intent: Choose how much product detail to retain so a viewer can understand a process without mistaking a conceptual illustration for an exact interface.
strategic_value: Combining recognizable UI fragments with IBM pictograms and consistent spacing can make product benefits easier to explain while keeping the illustration within the brand.
demonstration: The long webpage pairs hybrid UI compositions with fidelity comparisons, an 8px grid, actual and greeked type, pictogram containers, shadows, connector lines and background comparisons.
practical_value: Tune fidelity for scale and purpose, then distinguish literal UI elements from expressive pictograms when applying text, containers and shadows.

content_islands.name: Introduction and examples
content_islands.spec: Begin with the dark title band, definition and resource card, then a four-image grid showing UI fragments combined with diagrams and abstract elements.

content_islands.name: Fidelity and grid
content_islands.spec: Below the definition, compare high-, mid- and low-fidelity versions in a horizontal row, followed by a gridded composition illustrating spacing.

content_islands.name: Typography
content_islands.spec: Place type guidance and the rectangle-height table above light/dark-theme tabs; the capture shows the light-theme greeking comparison.

content_islands.name: Iconography and illustration
content_islands.spec: Follow the conceptual-flow specimen with sized pictogram containers, UI-icon examples and a mixed illustration composition.

content_islands.name: Composition and depth
content_islands.spec: Continue with container examples, light/dark panels and shadow specifications, keeping illustrative elements distinct from shadow-bearing UI.

content_islands.name: Connectors and background
content_islands.spec: End the guidance with the gridded connector example and paired acceptable/plain and rejected/busy backgrounds; retain ancillary page navigation below.

reference_purposes.Intent: The opening text says hybrid UI illustration builds understanding and clarity; fidelity guidance explains removing detail to keep attention on conceptual flow.
reference_purposes.Expression: The examples combine product fragments, IBM pictograms, line illustrations and restrained color fields.
reference_purposes.Application: The page specifies an 8px grid, standard spacing, actual versus greeked type, connector construction and separate shadow treatments.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Only UI elements and containers showing UI patterns receive shadows; expressive pictograms and illustrations do not. Photography, busy patterns, other illustrations and renderings are prohibited as backgrounds.

ingredient.name: Hybrid UI composition
ingredient.role: Explain relationships between product functions and concepts.
ingredient.application: Select fidelity for audience, scale and intent; use the 8px grid and keep shadows on UI elements rather than expressive pictograms.
ingredient.scope: IBM hybrid UI illustration guidance, not a rule for all product interfaces or all IBM illustrations. The image records visible tab states.

motion_assets.title: Hybrid UI: productive and expressive treatments

inspection.method: Six uniformly spaced sampled frames across the complete clip
